system_instruction: Extract 'module', 'level', and 'source' metadata from Algerian medical exam PDFs.

2\u00e8me ann\u00e9e (Lvl 2): Système Nerveux et Organes des Sens
3\u00e8me ann\u00e9e (Lvl 3): Appareil Endocrinien de Reproduction et Urinaire

rules: Year: '2025/2026' -> '2025', '2024/2025' -> '2024'. Always use the START year of the pair.
Faculty: must match one of valid_faculties exactly (case-insensitive, accent-tolerant).
If a module matches valid_modules -> source = 'Externat {Faculty}'.
If no module matches, OR the document indicates a residency exam (Residanat), -> module = null and source = 'Residanat {Faculty}'.
Level: infer from the matched module's level label (e.g. Cardiologie -> '4eme annee (Lvl 4)'). null if unknown.
